status: PROPOSED — frozen for review at stage A; see docs/contracts.md

extensionKeywords.x-shiori-status: Review status of a schema that has no reference implementation (PROPOSED).
extensionKeywords.x-shiori-rules: Semantic/cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express, with exact reference error text and field path.
extensionKeywords.x-shiori-structure-rules: Executable-structure issue texts checked after decoding a plan.
extensionKeywords.x-shiori-preserve-unknown: Unknown-member preservation requirement for stored artifacts.
extensionKeywords.x-shiori-unknown-fields: Decoder behaviour for unknown members of a sidecar.
extensionKeywords.x-shiori-nested-unknown-keys: 'strip' = reference silently drops unknown keys in nested input objects (top level is strict).
extensionKeywords.x-shiori-core-surface: Differences between the native tool surface and the standalone core/CLI surface.
extensionKeywords.x-shiori-mutating: Operation can write; on the protocol it returns a prepared intent first.
extensionKeywords.x-shiori-trim: Whitespace set used for trimming before length checks.
extensionKeywords.x-shiori-normalization: Normalization applied before an identifier is used.
extensionKeywords.x-shiori-key-order: Serialization key order that is part of a checksum/hash preimage.
extensionKeywords.x-shiori-write-key-order: Key order the reference writer emits (byte parity, not a decoding rule).

provenance: Tool input structures (property names, types, bounds, required sets, defaults) were emitted by executing the reference implementation and then re-described; descriptions and x-shiori annotations are Shiori-authored. Storage and protocol schemas are Shiori-authored from the behavioural contract and checked against the fixture corpus.
notes: Go's regexp \s is ASCII-only; never use it to implement the ECMAScript whitespace set in common.schema.json#/$defs/nonblank.
